theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_tc_cl_bim_boundary_im_of_compact_support
theorems.statement: (∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : NNReal, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 0 < ρ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsCompact T.support → T.mass < ∞ → T.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity Q ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Q.boundary ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ T - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ (Q = 0 ∨ ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ Q.mass) ∧ Q.mass ≤ c * T.mass ∧ Q.boundary.mass ≤ c * T.boundary.mass ∧ R.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.mass ∧ S.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.boundary.mass ∧ Q.support ∪ R.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.support ∧ Q.boundary.support ∪ S.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.boundary.support) → ∀ (P d : ℕ), d + 1 < P → (∀ (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U d) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsCompact T.support → T.mass < ∞ → T.boundary.mass < ∞ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T.boundary
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
